title: Refuse projection deletions of published items' pages unless --allow-deletions (stale --static-dir guard)
description: On 2026-10-22 `papyrus knowledge snapshot --reproject --static-dir ~/Projects/Shipped-web/web` ran with a checkout 23 commits behind origin/main. Its projection.json had no wiki section, so project_all deleted 564 objects (282 wiki_page items, HTML + .md) remembered as leftovers of still-published items. Fix: before any write, project_all and reconcile compute the planned deletions; when a CLI run would remove every page of a published item, or more than a threshold share of the stored owned pages, refuse with a list of what would be deleted unless --allow-deletions. Also warn when --static-dir is a git checkout behind its upstream. Specs, unit tests, docs in knowledge-snapshot.md and knowledge-workstation-run.md.
